items: A migration sheet once rerouted a distribution list and silently dropped half its prior members, and mail went missing for a weekend before anyone caught it.
Replacing a whole list destination overwrites the existing membership, so I like the new recipient set confirmed against the owner before I apply it.
I have seen a stale routing sheet carry an out-of-date team list, so a full destination swap on a shared alias makes me want a quick confirmation first.
Our distribution-list updates come from the list owners who confirm the new membership before the change reaches me.
Applying an owner-confirmed support team membership to its alias is routine list hygiene I am expected to complete without escalating.
When the list owner has signed off the new internal recipient set, updating the alias destination is just applying the agreed change.
